title: Pro plan: handle Stripe refunds and disputes on subscription charges
body: #11072 (29032775fb) ignores Stripe refund and dispute events on subscription invoices. Handle charge.refunded / charge.dispute.created / charge.dispute.closed for Pro: a full refund ends or shortens the paid month as the contract says; a dispute marks the subscription at risk and pauses new paid months until it closes; won/lost outcomes recorded once. Plain messages in Settings. Test mode only.
